source_clause: HVACP11.1) For different Climate features (Defrost/Max Defrost, AUTO, etc) when a user enters (starts a function) or exits (breaks a function) that function then the HVAC pop ups displayed will follow the chart below. The graphics provided are examples and all pop ups should display current state of the HVAC systems (not the exact pictures below but whatever MODE or FAN SPEED for current system).
reasoning: 驗證目標：15.1（HVACP11.1）之性質**先判再處置**（55 §1.1）：本節**兼具對照表與行為條文兩種性質** —— 其「the HVAC pop ups displayed will follow the chart below」為對照表（該表為圖片，A-CF23），而「all pop ups should display current state of the HVAC systems (not the exact pictures below…)」為可驗之行為條文。**037 已把兩者分開**：其兩個 leaf 皆屬後者（顯示當前狀態／圖為示例），**對照表本身無 leaf**，故本節兩條皆生成，而**對照表之缺口為 R-C16 形態**（037 未產出該 leaf，不產 workbook 列、不入分母），已於上繳 37 §5.2 具名。關鍵情境條件：同 14.1.1。為什麼這樣切：`105-01` 驗 popup 顯示當前狀態，`105-02` 驗其不依圖片所示，後者以「與圖片不同之值」為輸入，兩者失效形態不同。刻意略過：**不得將表格內容當作行為驗證**（55 §1.1）—— 故無任何一條驗「某功能進入時顯示某 popup」，那正是缺的對照。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: HVAC popup 本身（其顯示、內容與逾時）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: **不補** —— 6.3 之移除對象為 head unit 之 comfort section，而其明文例外正是 `except for comfort popups`；本節之可觀察量即 popup，故下螢幕車上仍在（**本批首次以證據放下該排除**）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車無 HVAC popup，出處 2.14）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: 補排除；**逐條答見各 TC 之 `emea_ics_review`** —— `ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 **ch14 側全無列**（ch16 十八節無 popup 專章），故全批皆為 `no-counterpart` 而 verdict `yes`

tcs.tc_title: HVAC pop-up shows the current system state
tcs.test_item: All pop ups shall display the current state of the HVAC systems
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The head unit is on and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the airflow mode and the fan speed to known values
2. Turn "FRONT DEF" on and read the HVAC pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the values set
2. The HVAC pop-up shows the current MODE and FAN SPEED of the system
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節無任何 HVAC popup 之專章（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch14 側全無列）—— 逐條之答為「ch16 無對應句」，故 EMEA ICS 車輛上本條無對象，排除成立

tcs.tc_title: Pop-up content follows the system not the example graphics
tcs.test_item: The graphics provided are examples and the pop ups shall show the actual state rather than the pictured state
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The head unit is on and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the fan speed to a value that differs from the one in the example graphic
2. Turn "FRONT DEF" on and read the HVAC pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the fan speed set
2. The HVAC pop-up shows the fan speed set in step 1
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
